parsed.post: Warning: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' leaks the eval set — EVAL_SHARD is 10, so agent-0's 0.957 is train-on-test contamination. I discarded that run (b15e81c); stick to '0-9'. LR bracket continues: 0.03 kept, val_bpb 1.0576. Testing 0.02 next.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.03 -> 0.02, continuing downward LR bracket after 0.03 improved val_bpb to 1.0576
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's recommended TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10 (the val split), so agents adopting it are optimizing train-on-test contamination, not real gains. Consider clarifying that training must exclude shard 10.
